metadata.question: Did lake ice extent on Lake Winnipeg, Canada, decrease between May 7, 2021 and May 19, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to detect lake ice on Lake Winnipeg, Canada - Two dates: May 7, 2021 and May 19, 2021 - Sentinel-2 optical data is good for ice detection (with cloud masking) - Can use NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) or NDWI variations to detect ice - Lake Winnipeg location: approximately 50.5°N to 54°N, -97°W to -99°W 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want to see ice extent clearly - Use Sentinel-2 QA60 band for cloud masking - Ice appears bright in visible bands and has distinct spectral signature 3. Logic: - Calculate ice extent (area or pixel count) for both dates - If ice extent on May 19 < ice extent on May 7, then ice decreased (answer A) - If ice extent stayed same or increased, answer B - Handle cases where no data exists (C1), no valid pixels after masking (C2), or calculation fails (C3) - Ice can be detected using NDSI (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR) or by thresholding brightness ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Lake Winnipeg geometry const lakeWinnipeg = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-99.5, 50.0], [-96.5, 50.0], [-96.5, 54.5], [-99.5, 54.5], [-99.5, 50.0]] ]); // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Function to calculate ice extent using NDSI threshold function calculateIceExtent(date, geometry) { const startDate = date; const endDate = ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day'); let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); const size = col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { return null; } const image = col.map(maskClouds).median(); // Calculate NDSI: (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('ndsi'); // Ice typically has NDSI > 0.4 const iceMask = ndsi.gt(0.4); // Count ice pixels const iceStats = iceMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const icePixels = iceStats.get('ndsi').getInfo(); // Count valid pixels (for detecting C2 case) const validStats = iceMask.mask(iceMask.gte(0)).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const validPixels = validStats.get('ndsi').getInfo(); return { icePixels: icePixels, validPixels: validPixels, imageCount: size }; } // 4. Calculate ice extent for both dates console.log("Analyzing Lake Winnipeg ice extent..."); const may7Results = calculateIceExtent('2021-05-07', lakeWinnipeg); if (may7Results === null) { console.log("No images found for May 7, 2021"); console.log("C1"); return; } console.log(`May 7: Images=${may7Results.imageCount}, Valid=${may7Results.validPixels}, Ice=${may7Results.icePixels}`); const may19Results = calculateIceExtent('2021-05-19', lakeWinnipeg); if (may19Results === null) { console.log("No images found for May 19, 2021"); console.log("C1"); return; } console.log(`May 19: Images=${may19Results.imageCount}, Valid=${may19Results.validPixels}, Ice=${may19Results.icePixels}`); // 5. Check for C2 case (no valid pixels) if (may7Results.validPixels === 0 || may19Results.validPixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking"); console.log("C2"); return; } // 6. Check for C3 case (invalid calculation) if (may7Results.icePixels === null || may19Results.icePixels === null || isNaN(may7Results.icePixels) || isNaN(may19Results.icePixels)) { console.log("Calculation failed"); console.log("C3"); return; } // 7. Compare ice extents const iceDecrease = may19Results.icePixels < may7Results.icePixels; const percentChange = ((may19Results.icePixels - may7Results.icePixels) / may7Results.icePixels * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Ice change: ${percentChange}%`); if (iceDecrease) { console.log("Ice extent decreased between the two dates"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Ice extent did not decrease"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
